method: Exhaustive exact 5-word shingle Jaccard nearest-neighbor search, using inverted postings; no approximate MinHash.
normalization: NFC + casefold + Unicode letter/mark/number words; retain internal hyphens and underscores; no stopword removal.
scope: Train = SFT + both GRPO pools; validation excluded from text comparisons; all six splits included in 15 pairwise identifier checks.
interpretation: Identifier separation and zero exact prompt duplicates hold. Natural-language templates and common system/tool instructions recur; similarity is not proof of semantic independence. Repeated scalar answers on different entities/parameters or incident calculations are reported explicitly, not declared zero leakage.
